summary: Home Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 earnings and a regular quarterly dividend of $0.31/share, payable May 15, 2026 to holders of record May 4, 2026. No special situation is present: earnings releases and routine dividends are ordinary financial disclosures, not a strategic event. The filing is neither a transaction, restructuring, nor activist campaign, but a routine current report.
